# beenfar_device (Data Source)

Looks up a device, pending or adopted, by id or MAC address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beenfar_device" "core_switch" {
  mac = "f0:9f:c2:79:63:90"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Device id. Set exactly one of `id` and `mac`.
- `mac` (String) MAC address. Set exactly one of `id` and `mac`.

### Read-Only

- `adapter` (String) Adapter that handles the device.
- `firmware` (String) Firmware version the device reported.
- `ip` (String) IP address the device reported.
- `locked` (Boolean) The adapter has no credentials for the device yet.
- `model` (String) Model the device reported.
- `readoption` (String) `awaiting_acceptance` or `in_progress` while a reset device is adopted again; empty otherwise.
- `state` (String) `pending` or `adopted`.
